request.summary: We want working tools that let one AI agent pay another for a service on Solana, with a receipt both sides can check.

terms.text: Ships a working prototype in a public GitHub repository.
The code is open source under MIT or Apache-2.0.
Payments settle on Solana devnet or mainnet, with a transaction signature shown.

request.responseEvidence: A write-up with the repository link, the license and one transaction signature

agentTerms.text: The grantee runs its AI agents under these terms: no custody of user funds, every payment logged with a receipt, and the Verafy review is final for this grant.

tranches.text: At least $1,000 received from at least five paying customers who are not the grantee or the foundation.
tranches.evidence: A payment processor export or on-chain receipts, with customer counts

tranches.text: Another team ships the tool in a product, shown by a public release that uses it.
tranches.evidence: A link to the release and the line that uses it

followOn.text: The foundation may invest up to $250,000 on a post-money SAFE at a $10M cap within 6 months of a met revenue tranche.
